claims.claim: Very clean UK-Used PS4 Pro Console
claims.evidence: Witness only reports PS4/ DualShock 4 bundle box graphics and a Sony logo; no CUH model/version or condition details (scratches/dents/overheating) are shown.
Witness report does not show any game discs/cases or a list of games.
Witness notes no controller is clearly shown outside the box; only controller imagery on the boxes is mentioned, not physical inclusion or quantity.

risks.risk: Exact PS4 model/version and storage capacity are unknown (e.g., PS4 Pro vs other PS4, HDD size). This affects value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console label showing the CUH model number and the storage/HDD capacity (or a screenshot from Settings > Storage).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic PS4 bundle with unknown storage and no confirmed PS4 Pro status.

risks.risk: Working condition is unknown (disc drive, ports, Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth, overheating).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the console powering on to the home screen, plus a quick test of disc drive (if discs are claimed), and a Settings screen showing Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth status.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not tested/unknown working condition.

risks.risk: Controllers may be missing or may have issues (stick drift, unresponsive buttons).
risks.proof: Photos/videos of the physical DualShock 4 controllers outside the box showing both analog sticks/buttons, plus a quick input test (moving sticks in a controller test screen).
risks.if_unproven: Price as one controller or controllers not confirmed, with worst-case controller condition.

risks.risk: Accessories may be incomplete or non-original (power/HDMI/USB/headset/manuals).
risks.proof: A laid-out photo showing every included accessory with close-ups of ports/cables and any brand markings.

risks.risk: Account status may be problematic (not signed out, bans, or setup issues).
risks.proof: A photo/video showing the console at the sign-in/setup screen (or Settings > Users showing it is signed out / can create a new user).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming account/setup may be restricted.

risks.risk: Games may not actually be included (seller claim of 10 games not supported by the witness).
risks.proof: A photo of all game discs/cases laid out with titles visible (or a screenshot list of installed games if digital).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console’s label showing the CUH model number and storage capacity (or Settings > Storage screenshot).
Video clip: power on to the PS4 home screen; show Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth working (Settings screen).
Photos/videos of the physical controllers outside the box (show both pads) and a quick controller input test for stick drift/button response.
Photo of all accessories laid out (power cable, HDMI, USB, headset, manuals) to confirm completeness and originality.
Photo/video showing the console user/account state (signed out / can set up normally).
Photo of the claimed 10 games (titles visible) or confirmation whether they are installed digitally.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a PS4/DualShock 4 bundle from box graphics, but key value drivers (exact PS4 Pro model, storage, working status, controllers physically included, and games) are not verifiable from the report. I will price at the worst-case within that identification, treating it as untested/unknown and with no confirmed games/controllers beyond what’s shown.
